data.gender_notes: Godewyn is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English 'Goda' (God) and 'wine' (friend). This name was popular among the Anglo-Saxon and Norman nobility, signifying a deep connection to God and the divine. The name Godewyn carries the meaning “God's friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Godewyn usually hope their child will grow to embody god's friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Godewyn total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
